description: Land Title Settle Department - Koholankala, Hambantota D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830109 (16/0675 - Hambantota)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extents, and other land-related particulars. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration and title settlement processes, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
